verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents 'departmental budget controls' within Expense Management and card-level spend limits, including custom caps, policies embedded in the card program, and limits with reset intervals. That supports the core idea, but department budgets get only one thin mention, and enforcement is shown at the card or employee level rather than as a department or program budget that automatically blocks spend. missing for 10: program-level budgets, documentation of how departmental budgets are set and automatically enforced (e.g. declines when a budget is exhausted), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: Adjust spend limits instantly, embed expense policies into your card program, and review every purchase in real-time.
Spend Limits: Cap employees' spend with card controls and custom limits.
